title: Provider-native web search
highlights: Web search now uses your model provider's own server-side search (Anthropic and OpenAI) by default instead of scraping from your machine, shown as regular web search rows live and on resume (thanks @johnnyfish)
improvements: Set websearch.prefer_native = false or JCODE_WEBSEARCH_PREFER_NATIVE=0 to keep using local search engines
Provider-side search follows each session's allowed and disabled tool policy
SDK apps that register their own websearch tool keep it instead of having it replaced by provider search
Installing a skill mid-session no longer invalidates the prompt cache, so the next turn stays fast and cheap
When switching providers, earlier native search results are summarized clearly so the model does not retract correct answers
fixes: Copilot uses the authenticated Business or Enterprise API host and live model endpoint metadata, fixing Responses-only model requests such as GPT-6 Luna
Copilot catalog refresh preserves explicit model selections and selects defaults only from available picker models
Copilot catalog discovery is bounded, API host changes refresh model routes, and picker updates publish atomically
Copilot fingerprints retain session context, and concurrent requests for unknown models wait for endpoint metadata instead of guessing a route
OpenAI login validation no longer hangs when the account hits a usage limit
Retrying a turn no longer leaves web search rows from the aborted attempt
Interrupted Anthropic turns that used native search no longer risk a request error on the next message
